cues.en: With the templates done, let's now create the Withdrawal Alert email service.
cues.zh: 範本完成後，建立提款通知郵件服務。

cues.en: So you're going to go back to the Project Explorer.
Then again to go to backend up.
Then you're going to go to core.
Then you're going to go to services.
Then within services we're going to create a new file that's going to be withdrawal underscore alert dot pi.
Then let me close all this.
Then as usual we start with the inputs.
As you can see from decimal we're going to input decimal.
Then from date time we're going to import date time.
Then from backend.app.co dot emails dot base.
We're going to import email template.
Then from backend.app.co dot config we're going to import the settings.
Then we can create the alert email.
So that's going to be class withdrawal alert email.
That's going to subclass the email template.
Then the template name that's going to be the withdrawal underscore alert dot HTML.
Then the plain version that's going to be withdrawal underscore alert dot txt.
Then the subject that's going to be withdrawal a lot.
Then we can create the function to send the email.
So you can say async define a send underscore withdrawal alert to this function.
We're going to pass in the email that's going to be of type string.
Then the full name of type string.
Then the amount of a decimal type.
Then the account name that's going to be of type string.
Then the account number that's going to be of type string.
Then the currency that's going to be of type string, then description that's going to be of type string.
cues.zh: currency 與 description 的型別都為 str。

cues.en: And then the transaction date that's going to be datetime.
Then reference that's going to be of type string.
Then balance that's going to be over decimal type.
Then the function is going to return none.
Then we can now send the withdrawal alert email to the customer by first creating the context.
cues.zh: 先建立 context，再寄提款通知給客戶。

cues.en: So for the context we're going to pass in the full name.
As you can see full name.
That's going to be a full name.
Then the amount that's going to be amount, then the account name that's going to be account name, then account number.
cues.zh: amount 設為 amount，account_name 設為 account_name，再來 account_number。

cues.en: That's going to be account number.
Then the currency that's going to be currency then description that's going to be description.
cues.zh: currency 設為 currency，description 設為 description。

cues.en: Then transaction date.
That's going to be transaction date that we're going to format the time.
cues.zh: 使用 transaction_date，再格式化時間。

cues.en: And you're going to pass in the year, then the month, then the day, then the time in hours minutes and seconds, then passing the timezone which is going to be UTC.
cues.zh: 依序加入年、月、日，以及時、分、秒，時區為 UTC。

cues.en: Then we're going to have the reference.
That's going to be the reference.
Then the balance that's going to be balance, then the site name that's going to be from our settings we can get the site name, then the support email.
cues.zh: balance 設為 balance，site_name 從 settings 取得，再來 support_email。

cues.en: We can get that from our settings.
So you can say settings dot support email.
Then after that we can now send our email by saying await.
cues.zh: 接著使用 await 寄信。

cues.en: That's going to be withdrawal alert email dot send email.
Then the email to that's going to be the email and then the context that's going to be the context.
cues.zh: email_to 傳入 email，context 傳入 context。

cues.en: Then you can save that file.
Good.
That's it for this lecture.
In the next lecture we shall work on the withdrawal service.
